title: EspOS package manifest (current format, firmware 0.5.0)
description: manifest.json of an .espk package as firmware 0.5.0, tools/espk.py and the store read it (s3/docs/packages.md, docs/i18n.md). `espos check` applies these rules and more (file and code checks); this schema is for editors.

id.description: Reverse-domain name, unique, never changes (it names the folder on the card and the app's saved data). At most 48 characters; the dev console's APP command reads 23. The language packs dev.espos.lang.<tag> keep their tag's capitals.

part.description: "core" for the main part (it holds the full manifest); other parts of a big package carry only id, version, code, part (+ group, label, default, req).

code.description: A whole number that grows with every release (the store offers an update when the catalog's code is higher).

name.description: Short, plain; never "…" (the device shows text in full).

kind.description: js: main.js is the app (QuickJS, API level 1). native: data for an engine built into the firmware.

engine.description: What runs the package: js for kind js; pet, run, j2me for native packages; lang and font for the OS's language and font packs (tools/i18n.py).

min_fw.description: The firmware code it needs (0.3.0 = 300; j2me games 400; lang and font packs 500).

i18n.description: The name and description in other languages, by language tag (docs/i18n.md). The device shows the ones of the language it shows, the English name and desc otherwise.

icon.description: Used when there is no icon.jpg (a 120x120 baseline JPEG, square; the device rounds the corners).

bg.description: The two colours of the gradient.

perms.description: sound (sound.*), notify (notify(), notify.schedule, notify.cancel, app.badge). net and bg are reserved: no firmware grants them yet. Without a permission the call throws.

type.description: app (default) or pack (data for an engine, no icon on Home).

addon_of.description: The id of the app this package adds to (docs/packages.md §4b).

j2me.description: Java games (engine j2me): what the store shows. The device reads the MIDlet class from the jar's MANIFEST.MF.

lang.description: Engine lang and font: the language the pack is for.

font.description: In a language pack: the id of the font pack it needs (dev.espos.font.vi, .sc, .jp, .kr, .cyr).

license.description: Where the package comes from and under what licence (required for wrapped Java games).

parts.description: Core part only: what each part of a big package is (publish_pkg.py; wins over the parts' own fields).
